name: r5-e2-tc-ws-uniform-issue
author: solx-loop
description: The 950-1200 clk per-stage floor of our hand-written tcgen05 rings comes from code generation (H25 supported, source named). A single-lane MMA issuer (warp == 1 && lane == 0) makes nvcc wrap every UTCHMMA in an ELECT + BRA.U.ANY uniformity loop. A CUTLASS-style ring removes it: whole-warp producer and MMA loops, an elected issue, and the commit multicast to the empty barriers.
